prompt: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error in phrasal verb.
sentence: Gita got onto / the book / she was reading / this morning.
explanation: 'Got onto' is wrong for resuming/returning to reading; the correct phrasal verb is 'got back to (the book)'.

prompt: Which of the following sentences contains an error in the use of a phrasal verb?
options: Clean out the backyard this weekend.
The old lady broke down when she heard her son lost his job.
Make over the bed daily. It is a good habit.
Try your level best before you decide to give up.
explanation: The idiom is 'make the bed' (or 'make up the bed'); 'make over' means to remodel or transfer, so it is wrongly used here.

prompt: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
explanation: The sentence text is missing, so the erroneous segment cannot be verified; segment (A) is given as the answer by default.

prompt: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
sentence: Mother ordered John to switch on the light as it was time to sleep.
explanation: At bedtime the light would be turned off, so 'switch off' is the appropriate phrasal verb.
